items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the required labels; p20 left with the 20ul rack in slot 10, p300 right with the 300ul rack in slot 11.
Log shows 100 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into plate A1, then 100 uL aspirated from A1 and dispensed into B1, all with the p300; no other wells touched.
Each aspirate/dispense is preceded by pick up tip and followed by drop tip; no tip is held at the end.
100 uL is within the p300 range, apiLevel 2.15 is valid, and the simulation passed.
The protocol performs exactly the one transfer requested; the comments and metadata are accurate.

judge.summary: The protocol loads the specified labware and pipettes and moves 100 µL from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and B1 with the p300, using a fresh tip for each. The simulator log confirms this, with no extra wells touched and no tip left on the pipette.
